topic: enforce the workbook row cap AFTER period expansion
lesson: In mis-budget.parser.ts the 25,000-row cap is applied only to SOURCE GL rows, but each GL line row is expanded into one mis_budget row per date-headed month block (up to 12). Enforce the cap on the EXPANDED output row count (glRowCount * blockCount, or count emitted rows), not just source GL rows, so a workbook that fans out past the limit is rejected before any write (DoS/unbounded-memory bound). Reject with the same limit error the shared guard uses.
